verdict.rationale: The only bulk-relevant evidence is that users can import or sync contacts and activity data, which implies mass ingestion of many records at once. No bulk API endpoints, batch jobs, or multi-item update or delete operations are documented, and nothing shows the MCP server or SDKs acting on many items in a single operation. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints (e.g., bulk profile import or subscribe jobs), bulk update/delete across items, agent/MCP-driven bulk actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
